decision_gate: Must be approved before any production data-backend cutover.

targets.target_rpo: at most 5 minutes of committed data
targets.target_rto: restore critical read/write service within 4 hours
targets.design_consequence: transactional revision/audit, frequent durable backup or PITR-capable design, restore test required

targets.recoverability: provider data may be re-fetched; internal estimates, revisions and reconciliation are not fully reproducible
targets.target_rpo: at most 30 minutes for non-reproducible revisions and model ledger
targets.target_rto: restore governed financial reads within 8 hours
targets.design_consequence: protect internal/revision rows more strongly than re-fetchable provider snapshots

targets.recoverability: partly re-fetchable; provider windows and deleted upstream content may not be
targets.target_rpo: at most 1 hour for checkpoints and non-reproducible accepted items
targets.design_consequence: checkpoint/ledger has higher durability than re-fetchable payloads; missed-window reconciliation required

targets.recoverability: aggregates are reproducible only while validated raw input exists; some raw sources cannot be replayed
targets.target_rpo: at most 1 hour for window/checkpoint/retention state; raw-source tolerance recorded per source
targets.target_rto: restore ledger and latest aggregates within 24 hours
targets.design_consequence: do not treat raw and aggregate as one class; retention deletion requires complete aggregate and validation evidence

targets.target_rpo: zero accepted originals after durable ingestion acknowledgement
targets.design_consequence: internal/object storage plus off-VM backup; Git is not the artifact store

measurement_contract: Stage 5 restore exercises measure actual RPO/RTO; target approval does not claim those values are already achieved.
